steps.say: Sleep disorders divide into broken breathing, broken movement and broken dreaming, and each group has one classic history. Apnoea snores with choking, restless legs crawl in the evening, and dream enactment injures the bed partner. The overnight sleep study with leg leads with video separates them in one night. Asking the partner is often more informative than asking the patient.
steps.tx: Sleep disorders split into **breathing** (apnoea), **movement** (restless legs, periodic limbs) and **dreaming** (parasomnias, REM behaviour disorder) groups. **Snoring with choking** marks apnoea, evening **leg crawling** marks restless legs, and **dream enactment** marks REM behaviour disorder. **Polysomnography** with leg leads and video separates them.

steps.say: In obstructive apnoea the throat is closed dozens of times each night, and each closure is ended by a snort with a surge of pressure. Obesity with a thick neck with resistant hypertension with morning headaches is the phenotype. The apnoea hypopnoea index counts events per hour, with five marking disease and thirty marking severe disease. Driving risk with cardiac risk rises with the index, so severity decides urgency.
steps.tx: **Obstructive sleep apnoea** closes the airway repeatedly; each event ends with snort and pressure surge. **Obesity, thick neck, resistant hypertension** and morning headaches form the phenotype. **AHI** counts events per hour: **5 or more** is disease, **15 or more** moderate, **30 or more** severe. Severity plus sleepiness decides treatment.

steps.say: Continuous positive airway pressure splints the throat open and is the treatment of choice for moderate to severe disease. It cuts sleepiness with blood pressure with crash risk from the first week when worn all night. Mandibular devices suit mild disease with simple snoring, while weight loss with lateral sleep with alcohol avoidance helps every grade. Surgery is reserved for clear anatomic blockage.
steps.tx: **CPAP** splints the airway and is first line for moderate to severe apnoea. It cuts sleepiness, pressure and crash risk when worn **all night**. **Mandibular devices** suit mild disease. **Weight loss, lateral sleep and no alcohol** help every grade. **Surgery** is reserved for clear anatomic blockage like huge tonsils.

steps.say: Central apnoea forgets to breathe without any struggle, and it follows heart failure with stroke with opiates. Cheyne Stokes cycling with crescendo snoring points to a failing heart rather than a fat throat. The airway is open, so mandibular devices achieve nothing. Treating the heart with oxygen with adaptive servo ventilation in selected cases is the route, and opiates are tapered where possible.
steps.tx: **Central apnoea** pauses breathing without struggle in **heart failure, stroke and opiate** use. **Cheyne Stokes** cycling points to the heart, not the throat. **Opiates** are tapered where possible. **Heart failure** treatment comes first; **adaptive servo ventilation** suits selected cases without low ejection fraction.

points: Struggles, snores, fat throat, CPAP works
left.title: Obstructive

points: No struggle, weak heart, fix heart first
right.title: Central

steps.say: Restless legs cause an irresistible evening urge to move with crawling deep in the calves, eased by walking and worst at rest. Symptoms peak at night and ruin sleep onset, which separates them from cramps that strike in single muscles. Ferritin with iron studies is checked in every case, because low iron drives symptoms even without anaemia. Family history is positive in half the cases.
steps.tx: **Restless legs** cause evening **urge to move** with calf crawling, eased by walking, worst at rest. It ruins **sleep onset**, unlike cramps that seize single muscles. **Ferritin and iron studies** are checked in every case; low iron drives symptoms without anaemia. **Family history** is positive in half of cases.

steps.say: Iron replacement is the first treatment when ferritin is low, and it is the only move that fixes the cause. Dopamine agonists control the rest but augment with time, spreading symptoms earlier in the day, so the lowest dose for the shortest time is the rule. Gabapentinoids suit painful cases with evening dosing. Caffeine with antihistamines with alcohol worsens every case and is stopped first.
steps.tx: **Iron replacement** leads when ferritin is low and fixes the cause. **Dopamine agonists** control the rest but **augment** over time, so lowest dose rules. **Evening gabapentinoids** suit painful cases. **Caffeine, sedating antihistamines and alcohol** worsen symptoms and stop first. **Pregnancy** flares it; iron is safe, most drugs are not.

steps.say: Non rapid eye movement parasomnias rise from deep sleep in the first third of the night, and the child sits up confused with no memory next morning. Sleepwalking with sleep terrors with bedwetting belong here, and they run in families with triggers of fever with deprivation. Safety with reassurance is the treatment, because waking the child prolongs the episode. Most cases are outgrown by the teens.
steps.tx: **NREM parasomnias** (sleepwalking, terrors) rise from deep sleep in the **first third** of night with morning amnesia. They run in families and flare with **fever and deprivation**. **Safety plus reassurance** treats most; waking prolongs episodes. **Scheduled waking** before the usual time aborts frequent terrors. Most fade by teens.

steps.say: Dream enactment in an older man predicts Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies years before tremor appears. The muscle paralysis of dreaming is lost, so punches with kicks with falls injure the partner. Clonazepam at bedtime with melatonin suppresses most episodes, and the bedroom is made safe with padded floors. Every such patient is watched yearly for parkinsonism with cognitive decline.
steps.tx: **REM behaviour disorder** in older men predicts **Parkinson disease and Lewy body dementia** years ahead. Lost **REM atonia** lets dreams turn violent. **Clonazepam** at bedtime with **melatonin** suppresses episodes. **Bedroom safety** (mattress on floor, no sharps) starts at once. Yearly review hunts **parkinsonism and cognitive fall**.

steps.say: Chronic insomnia is kept alive by the bed becoming a place of worry, and tablets alone never retrain it. Cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia is the first line and beats pills at one year, using sleep restriction with stimulus control. Melatonin suits delayed sleep phase with jet lag, timed hours before desired sleep. Caffeine with screens with irregular hours is removed before any prescription is written.
steps.tx: **CBT for insomnia** (sleep restriction, stimulus control) is first line and beats pills long term. **Melatonin** suits delayed phase and jet lag when timed right. **Sleep hygiene** (fixed hours, no screens, no caffeine) precedes drugs. **Short hypnotic courses** are last resort in crises only, never nightly repeats.

steps.say: Frontal lobe seizures masquerade as sleepwalking but betray themselves by pattern. They strike several times a night at the same hour with bizarre dystonic posturing, while parasomnias strike once in deep sleep and wander. Video study with E E G separates them, and antiseizure drugs control the seizures that reassurance never touches. Misdiagnosis wastes years, so stereotypy is asked in every nocturnal event.
steps.tx: **Nocturnal frontal seizures** mimic parasomnias but are **brief, clustered and stereotyped** at the same hour with dystonic posturing. Parasomnias strike **once in deep sleep** and wander confused. **Video EEG** separates them. **Antiseizure drugs** control seizures; reassurance never does. **Stereotypy** is asked in every nocturnal event.

steps.say: For the exam, lock in five fifteen thirty for apnoea grades, C P A P first line, evening urge eased by movement for restless legs with iron first, dream enactment predicting Parkinson disease, and C B T first for insomnia. Clonazepam treats dream enactment and melatonin shifts phase. Memorise the facts in this table exactly as written and grade every apnoea by its index.
steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** **AHI 5, 15, 30** grades apnoea mild, moderate, severe. **CPAP** leads moderate to severe disease. Evening **urge eased by movement** with low ferritin marks restless legs; **iron** leads. **Dream enactment** in older men predicts **Parkinson disease**. **CBT** leads chronic insomnia.
